summary: include_commit_signature is ignored: agent commits lack the Co-Authored-By trailer
explanation: Mistral Vibe 2.26.0 defaults include_commit_signature to true, but its runtime never adds the commit-signature section to the system instructions (added in 2.26.1, vibe/app_server/_runtime.py), so commits the agent creates carry no 'Co-Authored-By: Mistral Vibe <vibe@mistral.ai>' trailer. Evidence requirement: a commit created by the agent in the session whose message (COMMIT_EDITMSG / git log) lacks the trailer, together with the model request's system message lacking any commit-signature section while the setting is at its default. A user instruction overriding the commit message format, or a disabled setting, does not establish this defect.
expected_behavior: With include_commit_signature at its default (true), commits created by the agent include the 'Co-Authored-By: Mistral Vibe <vibe@mistral.ai>' trailer.
observed_behavior: In 10 of 10 independent runs on 2.26.0 the agent's commit message was exactly 'Add a.py' with no trailer, and the 18 KB system message sent to the model contained no commit-signature section.

provenance.agent_version: historical release 2.26.0 (fixed in 2.26.1); the unit's install input was re-pinned to this release for the reproduction runs, which is not part of this PR
provenance.case_origin: custom (frozen Case written from the issue text)
provenance.reproduction: 10 of 10 valid independent ABB executions (fresh Suite and container each)
provenance.evidence_scope: Complete native ABB attempt directories; see reproduction.json for all runs.
